groups.title: Machine-readable project map (older, Korean) listing groups and their validators
Working agreement for how code under src/ is organised (state, areas, tests, style)
CI workflows: verify, full test run, and M2 3D-battle verify

risks.text: The M2 workflow only triggers on the m2/20v20-vertical-slice-v1 branch or PRs to main, with path filters, so m2 edits on other branches are not checked by CI.

groups.title: 3D 20v20 battle prototype (three.js in vendor/), page m2_prototype.html, independent of src/

risks.text: m2_verify.mjs checks sha1 hashes of M2_BattleSnapshot, M2_CombatProfiles, M2_SpatialGrid and the technical fixture; editing those files fails verify:m2 unless the hashes are updated.
Soldier models fail closed: every name in SOLDIER_ANIMATIONS must exist in both GLBs or loading throws and the battle falls back to box soldiers; GLBs come from tools/blender.
Bootstrap binds about 40 hard-coded element ids from m2_prototype.html; renaming an id breaks the page.
Simulation runs on a fixed 50 ms tick with at most 5 catch-up ticks and 250 ms frame cap; do not tie it to frame rate.

groups.title: Entry pages (index.html, battle2d.html, m2_prototype.html), verify scripts, package and Playwright config

risks.text: index.html loads only src/main.js; verify.mjs fails if a script is missing, a src module has a syntax error or a missing import, or a session-only absolute path appears.
m2_verify.mjs writes m2_verification_result.json at the repo root, which tests/run-all.mjs reads and deletes; run from the repo root.
battle2d.html is a legacy standalone page separate from src/battle2d.
Playwright runs two projects: m2-* specs under SwiftShader WebGL, all others without it because 2D canvas stalls under SwiftShader.

groups.title: Composition root: main.js wires storage and battle start into the app

risks.text: The battle2d module is imported dynamically on first battle, so a broken battle only fails at battle start, not page load.
Storage access is wrapped in try/catch so private-mode errors reach the menu; keep the wrapper.

groups.title: Self-contained 2D tactical battle: pure simulation plus canvas UI, one public startBattle

risks.text: Only index.js is the public face; the battle never reads or writes saved state or moves money, the caller applies loot and gold from the result.
index.js forces options.collectEvents=true for the screen; sim tests may run without it.
Simulation randomness goes through two seeded streams from core/rng so cosmetic draws never change a fight; no Math.random.
dispose() must remove canvas and controls from the container because battle-flow replaces container children and relies on it.

groups.title: Core state store, seeded RNG, calendar, ids, results and hashing

risks.text: State must be plain JSON: a Map, Set, Date or class instance makes transact fail with store_state_not_json; nested transactions fail.
A failed transaction leaves state and revision unchanged; success raises revision by exactly 1, which save revision guard and digest depend on.
RNG state is a plain integer; always call draw(draft.rng) so the state advances or replays diverge.

groups.title: One folder per game area (finance, settlements, politics, etc.) with rules, checks and daily steps

risks.text: Rules mutate the draft and may fail part-way with no undo; state stays unchanged only because store.transact discards the draft, so never call a rule outside transact.
Other areas import only from an area's index.js, never rules.js or checks.js.
Daily step order values form one global sequence (settlements 200-270, finance 500, followups 900); duplicate names throw.
Records keep the v1 save shape with per-record revision; changing a shape needs a conversion step in src/persist.
An area's state check registers only when its index.js is imported by src/game/areas.js.

groups.title: New-game state shape, campaign setup, daily runner and area wiring

risks.text: The daily runner is one transaction per day; lastProcessedDay advances only if every step succeeds, so one failing step blocks all later days.
Adding an area means importing it in areas.js, otherwise it has no state check and no daily steps.
Changing the state shape or schema version needs a migration in src/persist.

groups.title: Save/load with SHA-256 digest, storage wrapper and v1 save conversion

risks.text: Only schema version 2 loads; older v2-key saves fail with save_unknown_old_version and newer ones are never overwritten.
A hand-edited save fails save_digest_mismatch; saving is refused if the stored revision differs from the loaded one (other-tab guard).
Saving writes a staging key, reads back, then the final key and reads back; keep this order so a crash cannot lose a save.
The v1 key (ars_bellum_save_v1) is read and converted but never changed or deleted.
Load and save run every registered area check; any failure rejects the state.

groups.title: DOM screens (menu, world map, settlement panel) over the store, running battles via injected startBattle

risks.text: Build DOM with dom.js el(), never innerHTML, so game text is not parsed as markup.
URL params ?fakeBattle, ?seed, ?terrain=test are hooks used by browser specs; changing them breaks tests.
Battle onEnd is honoured once; battle-result turns the raw result into finance changes using rng.

groups.title: Check harness: node:test units, Playwright specs, and the required-check registry checks.json

risks.text: A test id missing from tests/checks.json, or a listed id without a result, fails npm test.
run-all spawns children with cwd=process.cwd() and reads m2_verification_result.json; run from the repo root.
Unit test names must start with a bracketed id like [area.thing.case], lowercase with dashes.
Browser tests serve the repo root through tests/support/static-server.mjs via the Playwright webServer.

groups.title: Blender/MakeHuman scripts that build the 3D soldier GLBs

risks.text: Scripts need Blender or MakeHuman and are run by no npm script; outputs are assets/models/*.glb that m2 loads.
Adding an animation clip needs both the script and SOLDIER_ANIMATIONS in m2 updated.

groups.title: Vendored three.js r184 for the 3D battle

risks.text: Vendored library: do not edit; m2 imports it from here and CI path-filters on vendor/three/r184.

rules.rule: Randomness only through draw(draft.rng) or core/rng, time only from draft.calendar; never Math.random or Date.now in rules or sims.
rules.why: Seeded replays and saves stop matching.

rules.rule: Nothing under src/ may import the old root-level game files.
rules.why: src/ is being rewritten area by area and must stand alone.

rules.rule: Change game state only inside store.transact; a failed rule discards the whole draft.
Failure codes are area_reason snake_case strings, stable once written.
rules.why: Callers and saves depend on them.

rules.rule: A record shape change must come with a conversion step in src/persist.
Other areas import a domain only through its index.js.
The v1 save key is never modified or deleted.
Every unit test id must be listed in tests/checks.json.
rules.why: npm test fails on unlisted or missing ids.

rules.rule: The battle2d module never touches saved state or money.
m2 code stays independent of src/ and imports only m2/ and vendor/.
